definitions.explanation: A demonstrative pronoun referring to something far from both the speaker and listener.

examples.japanese: あれ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
あれ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦{話|はな}していた→話す：00467_hanasu⟧あれ、⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧？
examples.english: What happened with that thing we were talking about yesterday?

examples.japanese: あれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}して→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っています→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧。
examples.english: Please call me when that is done. I'll be waiting here.

notes:
あれ is a demonstrative pronoun for things far from both the speaker and listener. Part of the ko-so-a-do system.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧: this (near speaker)
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧: that (near listener)
- あれ: that (far from both)
- ⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧: which one (question)

USAGE:
あれ can also refer to something both speaker and listener know about, even if not physically present: あれ、⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧？ (What happened with that thing?)

WATCH OUT:
To modify a noun, use ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧ instead: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧ (that book over there), not あれ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧.
